Stranger_1.text: Yes, I guess flowers are blooming now.

Stranger_2.text: The weather has been quiet as of late.

Stranger_3.text: You could say that about my cat, but I'd rather you didn't.

Stranger_4.text: We can go to the beach if we must. But don't expect me to rub lotion on your back.

Stranger_5.text: No, I'm not free next week.

Stranger_6.text: Sometimes I think the clouds are too close to the stars.

Stranger_8.text: I don't want to go to work tomorrow, either.
